notes.title: Practice Mode Update
notes.notes:
Practice Mode is here!

Having trouble using the Move Device? - Practice Mode will hone your targeting skills, whether throwing on full power to explode fruit, or a lighter throw for careful placement on a far away platform.

Beat your high score - See how many perfect shots you can get in a row. Practice Mode will save your best score to be beaten later.

Other changes-
- General level tweaks
- Main menu loads on startup
- Game progress shown in stats
- Some minor menu changes

Known Issues-
- Some stats may not be correct

notes.title: The 'Pixxie' Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]Change Log[/b][/u]

- Higgs and the LAP no longer collide. (This means the LAP can't kill you)
- You can fall further without dying.
- Red creature fire rate is reduced.
- Red bombs last longer.
- Various level tweaks.

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]

- Some stats may not be correct.

notes.title: Ziode Shadow Early Access Release August 27th
notes.notes:
Ziode Shadow, the brand new and unique 2D platform/puzzle game from Middle Man Games, releases in to early access August 27th.

Ziode Shadow is a unique 2D platform/puzzle game about a hungover planet explorer, and his unwanted bot companion. He must use his 'Move Device' to utilize many different objects, and manipulate his surroundings, enabling both him, and his support pod to navigate the terrain.

The whole campaign will be available from the start, with new features on the way.

Will you survive your mission to Ziode Shadow?
